card.name: The word strength in product labeling
card.fires_on: The word "Strength" or "strength" (including its plural ending) when it refers to the concentration of a drug product, as in switching between strengths or a table column header.

modes.description: "Strength" and its plural ending in the section title about switching between dosage forms and strengths.
